equivalent_unit_feedback.boundary: equivalent characteristic equation for parameter root locus, not an assertion of identical reference/output transfer or internal physical signals

root_locus_loop.boundary: state explicitly whether adjustable K is included in L or separated; the auxiliary loop need not equal an original physical open-loop path

positive_feedback.boundary: a positive inner loop alone does not determine overall stability; evaluate the complete signed interconnection

closed_transfer.boundary: a closed-loop transfer is tied to selected input/output ports; output disturbance differs from an input disturbance

unit_negative_feedback.boundary: unity measurement feedback does not mean unity closed-loop DC gain; reference and measured output must use consistent units

open_loop_system.inputDisturbanceComparison: r=0, d=0.5 added at plant input
open_loop_system.boundary: comparison concerns the specified disturbance port, not an unqualified claim that feedback always improves every performance metric

open_loop_gain.DCGain: unbounded due to integrator, not K
open_loop_gain.boundary: K is a gain multiplier in this normalized model; distinguish it from DC gain and gain margin, and preserve any source-specific parameter definition
